completed_milestone: Phase 2 Automation (last phase completed against its original acceptance criteria)
active_task: Phase 7 analytics wired and honest; office lift courier and ground-floor volume
next_task: Close the Phase 4-6 acceptance gaps: real search/research, real image/TTS providers, YouTube OAuth; then an analytics panel in the UI once a channel is connected
known_blockers: No provider is verified on a clean install: the seeded Ollama endpoint is recorded NOT_CONFIGURED until the Owner runs the check, so no model is assignable until then
No search/research provider: sources must be supplied manually or by known URL, so Phase 4 acceptance ('real research, independent fact checks') is not met
No visual or TTS provider: renders use placeholder frames, which QC blocks from publication, so Phase 5 acceptance is not met
No YouTube OAuth credentials: publishing is disabled by design until a YouTube connection is saved and verified, so Phase 6 acceptance ('private upload verified') is not met
Analytics returns HTTP 503 until a YouTube connection is verified, by design: there is no local substitute for what a platform measured, and nothing is estimated in its absence
Analytics has no UI panel yet; the endpoints are live and the data is empty until a channel is connected
